patch_description: Split the global rz_post parameter into rz_post_even (qubits 0,2,4,6) and rz_post_odd (qubits 1,3,5,7). This refines phase control to match the underlying even/odd parity symmetry already present in the RY layer, enabling better separation of hard samples and tighter generalization. The first prior program showed this improves worst_group_margin and convergence; applying it here should recover gains lost in the current slower convergence (480 vs 90 steps).
